NOTE: (NON-APPROVED, timeline corroboration only — do NOT cite in brief.) Tenth consecutive night of US strikes. First explosions ~11:16pm Monday near Sirik, Hormozgan. 11:30pm Bandar Abbas. 12:27am Chabahar and Konarak (governor of Chabahar confirmed airstrike). 12:30am Sirik, 12:40am Bandar Lengeh. 12:58am Bushehr air defences. 1:30am Bandar Lengeh. 1:33am mountainous area near Shiraz. 1:45am Bandar Abbas and Qeshm Island. Iran claimed new wave of missile/drone strikes on US positions; MQ-9 Reaper reportedly targeted.
